resources/en-pairs.bin: English word pairs

Built by tools/generate_en_pair_table.py from two files shipped with the
symspellpy package, version 6.10.2 (https://github.com/mammothb/symspellpy,
MIT License, Copyright (c) 2020 mmb L (Python port), Copyright (c) 2019
Wolf Garbe (SymSpell)):

    frequency_dictionary_en_82_765.txt
    frequency_bigramdictionary_en_243_342.txt

Those frequency lists are derived from the Google Books Ngram data
(http://storage.googleapis.com/books/ngrams/books/datasetsv2.html), which
is licensed under the Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported License
(https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/), and from the SCOWL word
lists (http://wordlist.aspell.net/).

The table holds no text: for each of 141,152 ordered word pairs it stores a
24-bit fingerprint and one number, how much more often the second word
follows the first than chance predicts.
